name: proposal
description: A change the assistant is asking permission for, with its answers next to the question: yes and no, and sometimes a third way, shown first. Use it when a change removes something, or when the assistant is guessing.

use.when: a change takes something away, or the assistant is guessing at what the person wants.
use.not: what the person clearly asked for, or anything reversible such as undo or pace.
use.with: nothing else; it sits under the conversation.

summary.description: The question in plain words. Say what would change and why it is being asked.

detail.description: One extra line naming exactly what would change, so nobody says yes to a surprise.

accept.description: URL the yes answer posts to.

dismiss.description: URL the no answer posts to.

instead.description: URL a third answer posts to, when there is another way to do what was asked, such as hiding instead of deleting. It is shown first, as the answer that keeps everything, and Yes becomes secondary.

insteadLabel.description: What the third answer says, such as Hide it instead.

from.description: The page the person is answering from, posted with the answer so they come back to it.

wcag.notes: A named group holding the question and its answers, so the question is announced with the buttons rather than separately (1.3.1). Nothing is preselected and nothing happens on a timer, so the change is only ever made on purpose (3.2.5). Every answer says what it does.

machine.identify: A group whose accessible name is the question. Read data-proposal for its id.
machine.operate: Activate one of the buttons. Nothing changes until you do.

props.detail: You signed in with a subscription, so the key setup step is no longer needed.

props.summary: Move the calendar into the side pane?

props.detail: 3 of 12 have something in it; that would be cleared, and it can't be undone. Hiding it instead keeps what they hold.
